statements.text: Let me ask you this: will you commit to terminating these partnerships with AI companies when the flagrantly violate basic decency and in the case of the nonconsensual sexual images that Chair Lofgren referenced violate laws?
statements.context: Spoken during a hearing on advancing America's AI Action Plan, addressed to a witness or official.

statements.text: There is no doubt that AI has the potential to be an incredible force for good, for creativity, for scientific advancement, but it also—like any great tool—has a lot of very large risks. [...] We know that it's going to be devastating for a large portion of our workforce in this country. There's already a huge, hugely problematic impacts on the creative community and intellectual property owners. [...] And certainly there's risk to human safety and to human health.
statements.context: Speaking at a hearing on advancing America's AI Action Plan, the lawmaker questions federal contracts with xAI's Grok model after it produced antisemitic outputs.
